Appendix 1
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 1] <Amended on March 11, 2025>
Criteria for revocation and suspension of environmental educator qualifications (related to Article 5)

General criteria
(a) Where there are two or more violations, the most severe disposition criteria shall apply. However, where two or more disposition criteria all prescribe suspension of qualification, the most severe disposition shall be increased by up to one-half of the remaining disposition criteria, within a period not exceeding the sum of the periods prescribed by all applicable disposition criteria.
(b) Administrative disposition criteria based on the number of violations shall apply where an administrative disposition has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding three years. The period shall be calculated by reference to the date on which the administrative disposition was imposed for the violation and the date on which the same violation committed again after that disposition was detected.
(c) When imposing an increased disposition under item (b), the applicable violation tier shall be the tier immediately following that of the disposition imposed before the violation (where two or more dispositions were imposed within the period specified in item (b), the highest such tier).
(d) When imposing suspension of qualification, the authority issuing the disposition may reduce the period by up to one-half, taking into account the motive, nature, severity, etc. of the violation.

Individual criteria

| Violation | Statutory basis | First violation | Second violation | Third violation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (a) Obtaining qualification by fraud or other improper means | Article 17(1)1 of the Act | Revocation of qualification | | |
| (b) Coming to fall under any subparagraph of Article 16(2) of the Act | Article 17(1)2 of the Act | Revocation of qualification | | |
| (c) Lending the certificate to another person in violation of Article 16(6) of the Act | Article 17(1)3 of the Act | Revocation of qualification | | |
| (d) Causing serious hindrance to environmental education intentionally or through gross negligence | Article 17(1)4 of the Act | Suspension of qualification for 1 year | Suspension of qualification for 3 years | Revocation of qualification |
